newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ATLETICO GAIN REVENGE WITH 2-1 WIN IN DORTMUND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO GAIN REVENGE WITH 2-1 WIN IN DORTMUND.

text.p: Atletico Madrid avenged their home defeat of two weeks ago by beating Borussia Dortmund 2-1 on Wednesday to go top of group B in the European Champions' League.

Dortmund, 1-0 winners in Madrid, initially looked able to control the game by sitting back and counter-attacking. Heiko Herrlich gave Madrid's offside trap the slip from a pass by Julio Cesar in the 17th minute to drill a low shot past goalkeeper Jose Francisco Molina.

But after half an hour the Spanish champions exploded into life. Yugoslav striker Milinko Pantic had Dortmund goalkeeper Stefan Klos at full stretch from a free kick, then left the defence standing to whip a shot against the far post from an acute angle.
Eight minutes from halftime Dortmund's badly depleted defence allowed Roberto a free header to give Madrid a deserved equaliser.
Five minutes later, from a free kick near the corner flag, Pantic curled the ball around Klos and in off the far post.
